div.p: Every project is different, but most follow the same rhythm. One project lead stays with you throughout.

li.p: We visit the space or review drawings, and agree goals, budget and timeline.
Lighting concept, calculations and a first selection of fixtures and finishes.
Final schedules and drawings. Fixtures are handcrafted and tested in Milan.
Installation support, programming, focusing and a final walkthrough.

div.p: Each ARQORA design takes between eighteen months and three years to develop and passes through more than forty hands.
Ideas start as pencil sketches and paper models, studied against architectural plans and real interiors.
Full-scale prototypes are spun, cast and blown by our artisan partners. AUREL went through forty-two versions.
Our engineers design LED engines, optics and thermal management, then measure every photometric curve in our lab.
Each fixture is finished, assembled and tested by hand in Milan before being individually numbered and packed.
